About the Role

We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join our Finance Engineering team. You will design, build, and maintain microservices and applications that power key financial workflows. This role is ideal for engineers with a solid backend foundation, familiarity with frontend technologies, and experience or interest in financial systems.

You will work across the stack and collaborate closely with product managers, DevOps, and other engineers to build resilient, scalable systems using modern cloud-native tools and best practices.

Responsibilities

Core Responsibilities:

Design and own microservices within the financial domain using Python and FastAPI
Implement robust unit, integration, and E2E testing strategies
Work with GraphQL and REST APIs to integrate external/internal services
Build secure, scalable backend systems deployed on AWS using Terraform, Docker, and Kubernetes
Collaborate with DevOps to enhance CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions
Monitor system health and performance using OpenTelemetry or equivalent observability tools
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to code reviews and system design discussions
Translate finance-specific requirements into technical solutions with product and stakeholders

For Less Experienced Engineers:

Consume and integrate GraphQL/REST APIs into backend and frontend features
Write basic unit tests and learn to extend test coverage under mentorship
Work with Git, GitHub, and follow structured GitHub workflow practices
Pair with senior engineers to gain exposure to Kubernetes, Argo CD, and financial systems
Continuously develop skills across backend and cloud technologies

Tech Stack

Languages: Python (FastAPI), TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js
Frontend: React (basic usage)
APIs: GraphQL, REST
Cloud & Infra: AWS, Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, Argo CD
CI/CD & Observability: GitHub Actions, OpenTelemetry
Version Control: Git, GitHub

Minimum Qualifications:

Solid programming skills in Python; familiarity with TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, React
Experience consuming REST and/or GraphQL APIs
Proficient with Git and common GitHub workflows
Familiarity with AWS and Docker
Exposure to CI/CD and testing best practices
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Ability to work in a collaborative, fast-paced environment

Preferred for Senior Candidates:

Experience designing and owning microservices
Strong background in unit, integration, and E2E testing
Hands-on with AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Argo CD
Experience with GitHub Actions, OpenTelemetry, and system monitoring
Previous experience working in the financial industry or on financial systems
Track record of mentoring engineers and driving technical initiatives

Nice to Have

Experience with event-driven architecture or message brokers (e.g., Kafka, SQS)
Domain expertise in accounting, payments, or reconciliation workflows
Contributions to open-source or finance tech communities

About the Role

We are seeking skilled Engineers (Junior and Senior levels) to join our growing Order Engineering team. You will be part of building and scaling our next-generation order processing platform, leveraging modern backend technologies and cloud-native infrastructure. Ideal candidates are passionate about clean code, scalable architecture, and solving real-world problems with technology.

Responsibilities

Junior Engineer:

Implement backend features and services using Python and FastAPI
Integrate with GraphQL/REST APIs and support frontend teams using TypeScript/React
Write clean, testable code and participate in code reviews
Collaborate with DevOps to deploy services to AWS using Docker and Terraform
Debug, monitor, and optimize system performance with guidance
Learn and contribute to CI/CD (GitHub Actions) and Kubernetes/Argo CD workflows
Work with Git and follow agile development practices

Senior Engineer:

Architect and implement scalable services with Python, FastAPI, and GraphQL/REST
Drive API design, domain modeling, and system scalability for the order domain
Lead code reviews and mentor junior developers
Own CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) and drive observability using OpenTelemetry
Optimize cloud deployments with AWS, Terraform, and Kubernetes/Argo CD
Collaborate cross-functionally with product, frontend, and QA teams
Champion engineering best practices and contribute to technical strategy

Tech Stack

Languages: Python (FastAPI), TypeScript, JavaScript (Node.js, React)
APIs: REST, GraphQL
Infra: AWS, Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, Argo CD
CI/CD & Observability: GitHub Actions, OpenTelemetry
Version Control: Git, GitHub

Requirements

Junior Engineer:

1-2 years experience in software development (internships count)
Strong foundation in Python; basic knowledge of TypeScript/JavaScript, React, and Node.js
Familiarity with AWS, Docker, and Git
Willingness to learn Kubernetes/Argo CD, GitHub Actions, and cloud-native deployment

Senior Engineer:

5+ years of backend development experience with production systems
Proficient in Python and modern API development (FastAPI, REST/GraphQL)
Strong experience with cloud (preferably AWS), infrastructure-as-code (Terraform)
Hands-on experience with CI/CD, Kubernetes, and observability
Ability to lead projects, mentor team members, and own delivery end-to-end

Nice to Have

Prior experience in order systems, e-commerce, or financial services
Contributions to open-source or tech blogs
Familiarity with event-driven architectures or message queues (e.g., Kafka, SQS)

We are looking for a skilled Full Stack Developer with hands-on experience in React, Python FastAPI, and .NET. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in developing scalable web applications, designing REST APIs.

Job Title- Generative AI Engineer

Location- Hyderabad/Bangalore

Roles and Responsibilities
We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Generative AI Engineer with deep expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Azure AI ecosystem. In this role, you will design, develop, and productionize GenAI-powered solutions that address real-world business problems. You will work closely with cross-functional teams including data engineering, product, and cloud engineering to build scalable, secure, and high-performance AI applications.
LLM GenAI Development Design, fine-tune, and deploy Large Language Models (LLMs) for enterprise use cases.
Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for contextual and domain-aware AI systems.
Azure AI Cloud Engineering Build and manage GenAI workloads using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure ML, and related Azure services.
Deploy scalable and secure AI workloads following best practices for identity, networking, data governance, and monitoring.
Solution Architecture Architect end-to-end AI systems combining LLMs, vector databases, RAG, caching layers, orchestration engines, and monitoring dashboards.
Integrate GenAI solutions with enterprise applications via APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures.
Data RAG Pipeline Engineering Implement data ingestion, embedding generation, and indexing pipelines using vector stores (e.g., Azure AI Search, Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma).
Enhance RAG pipelines with ranking, grounding, hallucination mitigation, and context optimization techniques.
Software Engineering Develop robust backend components using Python, FastAPI/Flask, and modern DevOps/CI-CD tools.
Write high-quality, maintainable, testable AI pipeline code.
Collaboration Impact Partner with product stakeholders to translate ambiguity into technical solutions.
Mentor junior engineers and champion GenAI best practices internally.

5-8 years of total professional experience in software/data/AI engineering.
Strong hands-on experience with Python and ecosystem libraries (Transformers, LangChain/LlamaIndex, FastAPI, PyTorch).
Proven experience building and deploying LLM-based solutions (GPT, Llama, Mistral, etc.).
Deep understanding of RAG architectures, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, and evaluation techniques.
Experience with Azure AI services:
Azure OpenAI
Azure AI Search (Vector Search)
Azure ML
Azure Cognitive Services
Experience with vector DBs (Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, FAISS, Chroma).
Strong grounding in NLP concepts, tokenization, embeddings, transformers, and model evaluation.
Experience building production-grade APIs, microservices, and scalable backend architecture.
Understanding of cloud security, responsible AI principles, and model governance.

Design, develop, and maintain RAG-based AI systems using Python and Azure AI services.
Build backend services using FastAPI, Flask, and Quart, with an emphasis on modular, scalable design.
Develop interactive UIs using React, npm, and Next.js.
Implement and optimize AI workflows using Azure OpenAI (LLMs), Azure AI Search, Cosmos DB, Storage Accounts, and related Azure-native components.
Design and build AI agents, including autonomous task agents, tool-using agents, and LLM function-calling architectures.
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient Python code for data ingestion, embedding pipelines, prompt flows, vector interactions, and retrieval logic.
Participate in architecture discussions to design fault-tolerant, production-grade AI systems.
Contribute to best practices related to observability, performance, scalability, and CI/CD.
Collaborate cross-functionally with product and cloud engineering teams to implement new features.
Contribute to Java-based services built using Spring Boot as part of the broader platform ecosystem.
